title: •IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)
caption: •IT-0 (Eyetee-Oh) (V)
game_text: Wherever you have a captive, your Force drains are +2. Once per game, may ▼ Hypo. Immune to Restraining Bolt and attrition < 3.
lore: Floating prisoner interrogation droid. Uses probes and needles to dispense truth drugs and perform ‘surgery.’ Sensors determine subject’s pain threshold and truthfulness.

notes: Droid (single droid disc, no ability). Stat row is two boxes: POWER 4 and a wide INTERROGATOR DROID box spanning the ability + third slots (no ABILITY box). The slip's bottom-strip caption appears to print a zero ('IT-0') while the sheet header prints 'IT-O' — transcribed as printed; likely a typo on the sheet. Icon column empty. 745 px scan ANH-D-ito.gif carries a 'D-E1' label (errata face); printed face is ANewHope-D-ito-decipher-archive.gif (350 px, also downloaded). No modern 'Virtual Set N' remake exists; the wiki's only (V) page is a Virtual Block 1 preview composite (VB1-D-ito-pre.gif) which is just the Original slip laid over the 350 px scan — downloaded to src/vs3/modern/ for reference but modern=null.
